get_sota_rank: get the best known rank of a matrix multiplication tensor T_{a, b, c}
get_sota_rank_zero: get the best known rank for a zero-dimension matrix multiplication tensor
get_sota_rank_hopcroft_kerr: get the best known rank using the Hopcroft and Kerr formula for dimension 2
get_sota_rank_alphatensor: get the best known rank discovered by AlphaTensor for dimensions 3 through 12
get_sota_rank_sorted: get the best known rank with input dimensions automatically sorted before lookup
